description: Source-backed authoring, baking, and runtime contract for FOnline map containers.

scope.support_note: The contract is generated for a pinned engine revision. Project map catalogs, custom metadata, gameplay semantics, and composition policy remain project-owned.
included: one or more ProtoMap anchors with nested map-addressed Critter and Item sections
map identity, placement ids, prototype references, ownership, and property overrides
mapper normalization, side-specific baking, and runtime materialization
engine-owned Map, Critter, and Item property catalogs
excluded: project-authored properties, prototype ids, map catalogs, and directory taxonomy
quest, encounter, balance, visual-kit, and level-design policy
runtime save records and dynamic entities created after map materialization
pathfinding, combat geometry, lighting design, and renderer-specific composition guidance

outputs.source_selection: Baking.ProtoFileExtensions plus at least one [ProtoMap] anchor
outputs.description: MapBaker emits one coupled server/client resource pair for every map declared by a ProtoMap anchor.

sections.name: Map prototype
sections.description: Declares map-level properties and starts the context used by following [$Name/Critter] and [$Name/Item] sections.

anchors: Invalid map format, no ProtoMap anchor declared

sections.name: Critter placement
sections.cardinality: zero or more per declared map
sections.description: Places a critter prototype and applies per-placement Critter property overrides.

sections.name: Item placement
sections.cardinality: zero or more per declared map
sections.description: Places a map, inventory, or container item and applies per-placement Item property overrides.

directives.name: $Name
directives.description: Selects the Map prototype id and both baked resource basenames. Without $Name the anchor resolves to the source basename; multi-map containers should name every anchor explicitly.

directives.name: $Parent
directives.description: Uses ordinary Map prototype inheritance during prototype baking. Mapper save output is flattened and does not preserve this directive.

directives.name: $Text <language>
directives.description: Contributes localized prototype text and is preserved as an extra ProtoMap field by mapper load/save.

anchors: Proto text key must start with $Text

directives.name: $Id
directives.description: Provides a shared placement identity used by ownership references. Missing, non-positive, or duplicate ids are repaired during load; authored maps should not rely on repair.

directives.name: $Proto
directives.description: Resolves the base Critter or Item prototype before placement overrides are applied.

ownerships.name: MapHex
ownerships.description: Places the item on a map hex. Static items must use this mode.

anchors: Item is not placed on map hex

ownerships.name: CritterInventory
ownerships.description: Creates a non-static item in the inventory of the placed critter identified by CritterId.

ownerships.name: ItemContainer
ownerships.description: Creates a non-static item inside the placed non-static item identified by ContainerId.

ownerships.name: Nowhere
ownerships.description: Exists in the enum but is not a supported authored map-placement mode.

anchors: Map item load produced item with unsupported ownership

rules.name: Configuration syntax
rules.requirement: Use INI-like repeated sections, key = value assignments, # comments, backslash continuation, and key += value append where the property parser supports it.

rules.name: Closed section set
rules.requirement: Use top-level ProtoMap anchors and nested <owner>/Critter or <owner>/Item sections only.
rules.description: [$Name/...] binds to the preceding anchor. An explicit owner must name a declared map; a contextual nested section before the first anchor is rejected.

anchors: expected a ProtoMap anchor or nested map content
Nested map section appears before any ProtoMap anchor

rules.name: Map identity
rules.requirement: Give every map in a multi-map container a unique ProtoMap $Name; a single unnamed anchor inherits the source basename.
rules.description: Map identity, targeted bake lookup, and baked output names come from declared map ids, not container filenames.

rules.name: Shared placement ids
rules.requirement: Use explicit positive ids unique across all Critter and Item sections in one map.
rules.description: The loader repairs omitted, non-positive, and duplicate ids, but repaired values can invalidate hand-authored owner references.

rules.name: Prototype resolution
rules.requirement: Every Critter and Item section must name an existing prototype with $Proto.
rules.description: Missing and unresolved prototypes are accumulated as map-load errors.

rules.name: Property overrides
rules.requirement: Use properties valid for the section receiver and bake side; values override the resolved base prototype.
rules.description: MapBaker copies the prototype properties, applies section text, validates resources, and serializes side-specific data.

rules.name: Normalized entity order
rules.requirement: Do not use textual interleaving as an ordering contract.
rules.description: The loader processes all Critter sections before all Item sections, and mapper save emits critters with inventory items before map items with direct children.

rules.name: Ownership references
rules.requirement: CritterInventory and ItemContainer placements must reference a materializable owner id through CritterId or ContainerId.
rules.description: Unmapped owner ids skip child creation; direct children of placed critters and non-static map items are the supported mapper/runtime shape.

rules.name: Static item placement
rules.requirement: A Static item must use MapHex ownership.
rules.description: Static items become immutable map-grid entries and contribute movement, shooting, trigger, and multihex state.

rules.name: Map bounds
rules.requirement: Critter Hex and MapHex item Hex values must be inside ProtoMap Size before runtime loading.
rules.description: Server load rejects invalid positions. Mapper editing commands may clamp positions, which is not a substitute for source validation.

rules.name: Side-specific bake
rules.requirement: Treat server and client map binaries as a coupled output and regenerate both after source or referenced prototype changes.
rules.description: The server receives critters and all items; the client receives visible static items and its required string hashes.

rules.name: Hidden static items
rules.requirement: Do not expect a Hidden static item entity in the client map payload.
rules.description: Its client-side property strings are still hashed, but the item record is omitted.

anchors: For hidden items keep only string hashes for client

rules.name: Runtime materialization
rules.requirement: Use Static only for immutable map-hex fixtures; use non-static placements for generated critters, map items, inventories, and containers.
rules.description: The server remaps authored ids for generated critters and non-static map items before attaching direct child items.

rules.name: Mapper round-trip
rules.requirement: Review mapper-saved diffs as normalized output, not byte-preserving serialization.
rules.description: The mapper emits $Name and normalized [$Name/...] sections for the edited map, retains $Text fields, flattens inherited map properties, and preserves sibling map blocks byte-exact in a multi-map container.

anchors: Sections of other maps are preserved byte-exact

rules.name: Multihex mesh serialization
rules.requirement: MultihexMesh must contain x/y coordinate pairs; mapper save normalizes it into backslash-continued pairs.
rules.description: An odd coordinate count fails mapper serialization.

anchors: Mapper item MultihexMesh field must contain x/y coordinate pairs

rules.name: Error aggregation
rules.requirement: Treat any accumulated entity load or property/resource validation error as a failed map bake.
rules.description: Entity diagnostics are logged individually before MapLoader or MapBaker throws the aggregate failure.
